<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">
 <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:12.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt .0001pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">THE SMITH&nbsp;&amp; WOLLENSKY RESTAURANT GROUP, INC.<br> AND SUBSIDIARIES</font></b></p> <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 24.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements January&nbsp;2, 2006 and January&nbsp;3, 2005 (Continued)<br> (in thousands, except shares and per share/unit amounts)</font></b></p>


<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Gift Certificates during the year ended January&nbsp;2,
2006, a change in estimate was deemed necessary. The impact of this change was
related to promotional gift cards and was to increase marketing and promotional
expense therefore increasing SWRG&#146;s net loss by $397 during the year ended January&nbsp;2,
2006.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><a name="a19RelatedPartyTransactions_101936"></a><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(19) Related Party Transactions</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">SWRG manages the Smith&nbsp;&amp; Wollensky restaurant
in New York City, and receives annual management fees of 2.3% of restaurant
sales. An affiliate of the Company&#146;s Chairman is a general and limited partner
of St. James, which owns the Smith&nbsp;&amp; Wollensky restaurant in New York
and the Names in the reserved territory, as well as a general and limited
partner of MW Realty Associates, which owns the property on which the New York
Smith&nbsp;&amp; Wollensky restaurant is located. Management fee revenue
relating to this agreement amounted to approximately $609, $609 and $547 for
Fiscal 2005, Fiscal 2004 and Fiscal 2003, respectively.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Pursuant to the Licensing Agreement with St. James,
SWRG obtained the rights and license to use the Names for $2,500. The License
Agreement also provides for additional payments to St. James relating to new
restaurant openings and also contains a provision for the payment of a
specified termination fee. During fiscal 2004 and 2003, SWRG paid $457 and
$224, respectively, in connection with the opening of Smith&nbsp;&amp;
Wollensky units in Houston, Texas and Boston, Massachusetts in fiscal 2004 and
the Smith&nbsp;&amp; Wollensky in Dallas, Texas in fiscal 2003. In addition,
SWRG must pay a royalty fee of 2% based upon annual gross sales for each
restaurant utilizing the Names, subject to certain annual minimums. During
fiscal 2005, 2004 and 2003, SWRG paid royalty fees of $1,830, $1,782 and
$1,418, respectively.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">On January&nbsp;19, 2006, SWRG (the &#147;Licensee&#148;),
signed an Amended and Restated Sale and License Agreement, dated as of January&nbsp;1,
2006 (the &#147;Amended Licensing Agreement&#148;), with St. James Associates, L.P. (the &#147;Licensor&#148;)
which provides for, among other things, a reduced licensing fee only for the
opening of Wollensky&#146;s Grills that are less than 9,000 square feet. Pursuant to
the Amended Licensing Agreement, the one-time opening fee paid to the Licensee
for each new additional Wollensky&#146;s Grill (&#147;Grill Opening Fee&#148;) will be at a
rate equal to 50% of the fee due under the original Licensing Agreement (see
Note&nbsp;7). In addition, the annual royalty fee (&#147;Grill Royalty Fee&#148;) will be
reduced from 2% to 1% for annual sales from Wollensky&#146;s Grills. Both the Grill
Opening Fee and Grill Royalty Fee are subject to maximum average per-person
checks that, if exceeded, could increase both the Grill Opening Fee and Grill
Royalty Fee, but not to exceed the opening fee and royalty fee contained in the
original Licensing Agreement. The terms of the amendment do not apply to the
existing Wollensky&#146;s Grills.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">One of
SWRG&#146;s directors has also provided consulting services to SWRG since 1997 on an
at-will basis for which he receives $500 per day plus reimbursement for
out-of-pocket expenses. In fiscal 2004 and fiscal 2003, the Company paid an
aggregate of&#160; $185 and $165,
respectively, for such consulting services. Effective January&nbsp;4, 2005,
this director became an employee of SWRG.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><a name="a20BenefitPlan_101941"></a><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(20) Benefit Plan</font></b></p>

or older upon completing six-months of service (500&nbsp;hours in any 6-month
period). Employees may contribute a percentage of their gross salaries as
defined in the plan, subject to limits prescribed by the IRS. SWRG
contributions are at the discretion of the Board of Directors. Participants
contributions and earnings are </font></p>

and determinable during the fourth quarter ended January 2, 2006.</font></p>

<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">
 <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:12.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt .0001pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">THE SMITH&nbsp;&amp; WOLLENSKY RESTAURANT GROUP, INC.<br> AND SUBSIDIARIES</font></b></p> <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 24.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements January&nbsp;2, 2006 and January&nbsp;3, 2005 (Continued)<br> (in thousands, except shares and per share/unit amounts)</font></b></p>


<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><a name="a22SubsequentEvents_102011"></a><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(22) Subsequent Events</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">On January&nbsp;19, 2006, SWRG signed an Amended and
Restated Sale and License Agreement, dated as of January&nbsp;1, 2006 with St.
James Associates, which provides for, among other things, a reduced licensing
fee only for the opening of Wollensky&#146;s Grills that are less than 9,000 square
feet. Pursuant to the Agreement, the Grill Opening Fee paid to the partnership
for each new Wollensky&#146;s Grill restaurant opening will be at a rate equal to
50% of the fee due under the original agreement. In addition, the Grill Royalty
Fee for Grills will be reduced from 2% to 1% of annual Wollensky&#146;s Grill sales.
Both the Grill Opening Fee and the Grill Royalty Fee are subject to maximum
average per-person checks that, if exceeded, could increase both the Grill
Opening Fee and Grill Royalty Fee, but not to exceed the licensing fee and
royalty fee contained in the original agreement. The terms of the amendment do
not apply to the existing Wollensky&#146;s Grills.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">On January&nbsp;27, 2006,
SWRG entered into a $5.0 million Credit Agreement with Morgan Stanley. Under
the Credit Agreement, SWRG is the borrower and Dallas S&amp;W, L.P., a
subsidiary of the borrower, along with SWRG are the Guarantors. The $5.0
million line can be used for general corporate purposes. SWRG may at anytime
repay advances on this line without penalty. The Credit Agreement provides for
a maximum available borrowing capacity of $5.0 million and expires on January&nbsp;27,
2009. Advances under this line of credit bear interest, at SWRG&#146;s election, at
either a fixed rate of the one-month LIBOR plus 2.5% per annum or prime minus
0.5%, payable on a monthly basis. The line is gauranteed by a security interest
in all of the personal property and fixtures of Dallas S&amp;W L.P. and SWRG.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><a name="a23Restatements_132817"></a><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(23) Restatements</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">On April 27, 2005, SWRG filed its Annual Report on
Form&nbsp;10-K which reflected the restatement of the consolidated balance
sheet as of December&nbsp;29, 2003 and the related consolidated statements of
income, stockholders&#146; equity and comprehensive income (loss) and cash flows for
the years ended December&nbsp;29, 2003 and December&nbsp;30, 2002 and the
accumulated deficit as of December&nbsp;30, 2002. The restatements related to
the accounting treatment for the April 2003 amendment to the lease for SWRG&#146;s
Las Vegas property, the accounting treatment for leasehold improvements funded
by landlord incentives or allowances under operating leases, the accounting for
lease terms, the accounting for the estimate of gift certificates that were
sold and deemed to have expired and certain other miscellaneous adjustments.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 24.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><a name="ScheduleIivaluationAndQualifyingA_190648"></a><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">SCHEDULE

2003 primarily relate to decreases in NOL carryovers.</p>
